observations: Photo 0: TV screen displaying autumn trees with bright red and orange leaves, sun flare in center. 'QLED' logo in top right corner. Watermark 'EVERCOOL ELECTRONICS' across screen.

Photo 1: TV screen showing a pink lily flower with green leaves. On-screen menu visible on left: 'QLED' and '55Q60B' clearly readable. 'QLED' logo in top right. Watermark 'EVERCOOL ELECTRONICS' across screen.

Photo 2: TV screen showing a green frog on a mossy branch. 'SAMSUNG' logo in top right corner. On-screen menu visible on left: 'Quantum HDR' and '55Q60B' visible. Watermark 'EVERCOOL ELECTRONICS' across screen.
All photos show the same TV from front-facing angle, mounted or placed against a white wall. No visible damage to screen or bezel in any photo.
The model number '55Q60B' is visible in photos 1 and 2, but the seller claims '50Q60B'.

claims.evidence: Photos 1 and 2 clearly show '55Q60B' on the on-screen menu. The seller's claim of '50Q60B' is incorrect.

claims.claim: Experience brilliant, long-lasting color with 100% Color Volume
claims.evidence: This is a technical specification claim. While the screen displays vibrant colors, remote inspection cannot verify the accuracy of '100% Color Volume' or long-term color retention.
The 'QLED' logo is visible in top right corner of all three photos, and the on-screen menu in photos 1 and 2 also shows 'QLED'.

risks.risk: Screen damage or dead pixels not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the screen under bright light, showing full screen area, especially corners and edges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially having screen defects, which would reduce value.

risks.risk: TV not working or missing remote/power cord
risks.proof: Video showing the TV turning on, displaying different inputs, and powering off. Also, photo of included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which would significantly reduce value.

risks.proof: Photo of the TV's physical label or back panel showing the model number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as 55Q60B, but buyer may expect 50-inch, which affects size and price expectations.

proof_requests: Photo of the TV's back panel or physical label showing the model number.
Video of the TV turning on, displaying different inputs, and powering off.
Photo of included accessories (remote, power cord, etc.).
Close-up photo of the screen under bright light, showing full screen area.
response.reason: The model number shown in photos (55Q60B) contradicts the seller's claim (50Q60B). While the TV is identifiable as a Samsung 55Q60B QLED, critical risks such as screen condition, functionality, and accessory inclusion cannot be verified remotely. Proof is needed to confirm model, working condition, and accessories before pricing.
